parsed.restated: ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, v n ≤ C * r ^ n
parsed.proof:
unfold QuantumParallelRepetition.HasExponentialBound
constructor
· rintro ⟨c, hc, C, hC, h⟩
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-c), Real.exp_pos _, Real.exp_lt_one (by linarith), C, hC, fun n => ?_⟩
  have key : Real.exp (-c * (n : ℝ)) = Real.exp (-c) ^ n := by
    calc Real.exp (-c * (n : ℝ)) = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * (-c)) := by
          congr 1; ring
      _ = Real.exp (-c) ^ n := Real.exp_nat_mul _ _
  rw [← key]
  exact h n
· rintro ⟨r, hr0, hr1, C, hC, h⟩
  refine ⟨-Real.log r, ?_, C, hC, fun n => ?_⟩
  · have := Real.log_neg hr0 hr1
    linarith
  · have key : Real.exp (-(-Real.log r) * (n : ℝ)) = r ^ n := by
      calc Real.exp (-(-Real.log r) * (n : ℝ)) = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * Real.log r) := by
            congr 1; ring
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log r) ^ n := Real.exp_nat_mul _ _
        _ = r ^ n := by rw [Real.exp_log hr0]
    rw [key]
    exact h n
